issues.message: W9/W10 terminal failure dispositions imply alternate states without matching next edges. Add explicit finalizer decision nodes and terminal receipt/cancellation nodes; bind C8 status guard and preserve no-effect cancellation race.
Exact reasons required by EV3/EV11 and W8 are not fully declared as typed component outputs. Declare comprehensive reason producers and align negative fixtures with C6 error enum.

Additional variants in EV2/EV9/EV11/EV14/EV17 are prose assertions rather than fully resolved fixtures. Replace variant assertions with dedicated concrete goldens and include them in reciprocal FM/release links.

limitations: Design review only. No business fixture assertion, city API, actual policy, provider reliability, human acknowledgement or production effect has been executed or verified.
Synthetic fixtures and budget prices are author-defined proposals, not measured production evidence.
Structural helper checks formats/relationships and does not implement the designed system.
